simple.meaning: דּוּד (dûwd) is a Hebrew action word meaning “a pot (for boiling ); also (by resemblance of shape) a basket.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 7 times in 1 Samuel, 2 Kings, 2 Chronicles, Job, Psalms, and 1 more, beginning at 1 Samuel 2:14. The surrounding contexts include family line, offering, death, kingship, priesthood, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to דּוּד (H1731) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: דּוּד (dûwd) / H1731 is traced through 1 Samuel 2:14, 2 Kings 10:7, 2 Chronicles 35:13, Job 41:12 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.short: a pot (for boiling ); also (by resemblance of shape) a basket
definitions.full: H1731. dud דּוּד noun masculine Jer 24:2 pot, jar (Aramaic דּוּדָא perhaps compare Syriac disturb , from the idea of boiling) — absolute דּוּד 1Sam 2:14 4 t.; plural דּוּדִים 2Kin 10:7 , דְּוַדִים 2Chr 35:13 ; plural construct דּוּדָאֵי Jer 24:1 — a. pot, kettle or cooking ( בִּשֵּׁל ) 1Sam 2:14 (|| כִּיּוֺר קַלַּחַת, מָּרוּר, ), 2Chr 35:13 (verb בִּשֵּׁל , || סִירוֺת צַלָּחוֺת, ) compare Job 41:12 ; b. receptacle for carrying, all Vrss basket , 2Kin 10:7 (heads of king's sons), Jer 24:2 (twice in verse) (figs) compare דּוּדָאֵי 24:1 , as if from a II.[[ דּוּדַי ]; Psa 81:7 (clay or bricks, || סֵבֶל ).
